title: Dedicated capacity orchestrator onboarding storyboard and microflow frames
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, handoff-ready storyboard and microflow frames for the Dedicated Capacity onboarding experience. Deliverables cover: capacity setup (three profile scenarios), orchestration heuristics visual (how requests route across reserved pools), autoscaling behavior explainer (burst vs. sustained), SLA contrast ribbon, and screenshot-ready states for docs and release notes. Include annotated microcopy for tooltips, failure/fallback states, and a compact capacity estimator widget with sample inputs for quickstart flows.
acceptance_criteria: Three high-fidelity storyboard sequences for low/typical/peak traffic profiles exported as PNGs and PDF
Orchestration heuristics diagram (vector) showing routing + fallback layers with short annotation copy
Autoscaling behavior explainer in 3 panels (steady growth, sudden burst, graceful degradation) with micro-interaction notes
SLA contrast ribbon art optimized for mobile and desktop screenshots
Capacity estimator widget mockups in light/dark themes and accessibility-checked color contrast
All assets uploaded to Figma and a handoff package (tokens, slices, spec sheet) added to Confluence
